$schema_note: Phase 5 machine-readable business approval gate. One entry per business decision that must be resolved before app.scripts.import_odoo_catalogue --apply is permitted to write to Odoo. This file records approvals; it is never written to by any script — check_catalogue_import_approvals.py only reads it. See docs/integrations/odoo-import-approval-gate.md for the enforcement mechanism and docs/catalogue/catalogue-decisions.json for the full 22-decision business record this file's decision_ids are drawn from (D03/D04/D08/D09/D10/D19).

decisions.title: Tax and price treatment

proposed_value.known_contradiction: PDP (src/routes/product.$id.tsx ~line 200) states 'All prices include VAT'; src/lib/store.ts selectTax()/selectTotal() adds 5% VAT on top of the cart subtotal as a separate line at checkout. This is a genuine, code-verified contradiction (D21), not resolved by this entry.

approved_value.known_contradiction: RESOLVED for the MVP: canonical catalogue prices are treated as VAT-inclusive. The Storefront must display the stored price as-is (the PDP's 'All prices include VAT' copy is correct) and checkout must not add a separate VAT line on top of it (fixes the D21 contradiction in src/lib/store.ts selectTax()/selectTotal()). No Odoo account.tax record is created or configured in this phase — odoo_sales_tax_record intentionally stays null by design, not as an open question.

decisions.approval_notes: APPROVED in Phase 6 kickoff instructions: prices are VAT-inclusive for the MVP; do not create/configure Odoo tax records this phase. Carried forward from data/catalogue/catalogue-decisions.json D08/D21. Odoo-side tax setup (zero account.tax records exist on terrific_dev despite l10n_sa/l10n_sa_withholding_tax/l10n_gcc_invoice being installed; res.company(id=1).account_price_include='tax_excluded') remains unresolved but is explicitly out of scope for this phase — no Odoo write in this phase touches tax at all.

evidence.odoo_verification: docs/integrations/odoo-operations-runbook.md — account.tax search_count returns 0 (both filtered to type_tax_use='sale' and unfiltered) on terrific_dev as of 2026-07-28.

decisions.title: Odoo native product-attribute/variant modeling activation

proposed_value.affected_products: variant_parent products (26 total: buttercream-cake plus 25 more added in the 'real variant pricing' rollout)
proposed_value.risk: Creates new Odoo master data (attributes are shared across products, not 1:1 like categories/templates) — a matching bug could duplicate a shared attribute across multiple --apply runs.
proposed_value.safeguard: plan_attributes()/plan_variants() re-run their live exact-name match on every invocation (never cached across runs); run_reconcile is extended with a duplicate-attribute-name detection check; unlink/archive on any attribute-family model is never on the write allowlist.
